notes: WeatherStar 4000+ is a static jQuery/canvas front end (index.html hosting twc3.html in an iframe) whose only backend is an ASP.NET CORS proxy to NWS/NOAA and other weather services. start.sh runs .ui-capture/stub/server.js (node pinned in mise.toml) on $PORT, serving the repo as-is and stubbing every upstream through the app's own /cors/?u= endpoint. One app source change: Scripts/twc3.js guards the play and music timers (NavigatePlayToggle, AudioPlayToggle) against _WeatherParameters still being null. index.js starts those timers when the iframe loads, before twc3.js finishes its 250ms setTimeout init, which threw "Cannot read properties of null (reading Progress)" on the first ticks. Otherwise the server only injects one <script> (stub/shim.js) after jQuery. Data: all services render one consistent synthetic weather world generated from the current date: a late-season Pacific storm comes ashore over Southern California tonight (showers likely today, heavy rain tonight, clearing Thursday), then tracks over the Four Corners, Plains, Midwest and Great Lakes during the week, with lake-effect showers in upstate NY, Florida showers and PNW showers later. Established-user state: on first visit the shim seeds localStorage the way index.js does after a user picks a location: saved query 'San Diego, California, USA' with its coordinates, English units, Classic theme, auto-refresh on, auto-play on, music muted, narration off, hazard scroll on, plus a saved custom scroll text and RSS URL (not selected). The app opens straight into San Diego (station KSAN, zone CAZ043, radar NKX, ZIP 92101) and cycles through Current Conditions, Latest Observations, Travel Forecast, Regional Forecast/Observations, Local Forecast, Extended Forecast, Almanac/Tides/Outlook, Air Quality, Marine Forecast, Local Radar and Hazardous Weather (3 active alerts). The menu button opens the segment menu; the controls below the TV set location, units, themes, scroll text and auto refresh. Searching another city works through the stubbed geocoder (weather is generated for any lat/lon). Verification: twc3.html run under jsdom with faked canvas (all 12 Progress segments reach Loaded, no uncaught errors including when play/music are toggled before init); a real Chromium could not run inside this sandbox.
